adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, unknown usernames are explicitly ignored (`if user = User.find_by_username(username) ... end`), and the action returns `success_json` as long as `group.save` returns truthy—there’s no check that any users were actually added. The Ember action `addMembers` also doesn’t handle/display any server-side “nothing added” feedback; it just calls `model.addMembers(...)` and reloads members. However, this “silent skip” behavior appears consistent with the prior implementation (the removed spec previously asserted silent success when adding non-existent users), so it’s a real UX/behavior concern but not a clearly unintended defect based solely on the diff.
